the_lambda_1p0_record_this_wave_extends.note: Sealed frozen-fifteen counts, read off the ledger.  Three points exist and all three are on the CL896 body.
the_lambda_1p0_record_this_wave_extends.the_pattern: MONOTONE IN K.  Every step down the vocabulary axis buys lambda 1.0 another case relative to its control, across the whole span that has been measured.  Wave 36 registered lambda 1.0 at TWO on the K=9,216 base and read FOUR; that miss is what makes this trend worth registering rather than assuming.
the_lambda_1p0_record_this_wave_extends.the_objective_says_the_opposite: On the K=9,216 base lambda 1.0's held-out logit relSSE went 0.1844 -> 0.1785 against lambda 0.3's 0.1844 -> 0.1769.  The WORSE objective won the review.  Seventh time in this campaign the solver's own criterion has ordered the arms backwards, and the first time the arms were the two ends of the lambda ladder.

the_one_code_path_this_wave_leans_on_tha.what: --excise on a block that is NOT the last one.
the_one_code_path_this_wave_leans_on_tha.why_it_is_a_risk: Lfm2Model picks each block's attention mask by POSITION in config.layer_types.  Excising block 13 (the final conv) shifts nothing.  Excising block 9 shifts blocks 10-13 down one slot, so a full_attention block lands in a conv's index.  A builder that deletes the module without re-deriving layer_types for the LIVE model hands that block the padding mask -- None on this corpus -- instead of the causal one.
the_one_code_path_this_wave_leans_on_tha.what_it_cost_the_last_time_it_was_missin: mx18_mask_probe.py measured 0.0000 future attention mass with block 13 alone excised and 28.6% to 48.0% once anything shifts.  Wave 17's ARCH.F1301KV6Q is the body that carries it; wave 29 bisected it.
registered_in_advance: cut_wave37.py --audit asserts `harness.model.config.layer_types = [` and `so the live mask follows the live block` are both present in mx37_build.py, at a pinned count of one each, BEFORE the build.  ALREADY RUN AND PASSED at the tree cut.

The build log for CL896X09 must carry the line 'excised blocks [9]; child depth 13; config.layer_types re-derived (13 entries) so the live mask follows the live block'.  If it does not, the body is not built on and the finding is reported as a defect in the excision path rather than as a result about block 9.

The EXPORTED child's config.json layer_types must be the parent's fourteen with index 9 removed: conv conv full_attention conv full_attention conv full_attention conv full_attention full_attention conv full_attention conv.  Note the DOUBLE full_attention at positions 8 and 9, which the parent never has -- that is the shift, and it is what makes this body structurally different from every X13 body in the estate at the same parameter count.

predictions.source: MX37-V14CL896, rebuilt this wave from wave 34's retained MX34-CL896 by one CPU vocabulary pass at K=14,336, checked BIT-IDENTICAL against wave 35's sealed f93af77c25340120 before any solve runs on it
predictions.reasoning: THE MONOTONE-IN-K PRIOR.  lambda 1.0's gain over its control is +0 at K=12,288, +1 at K=10,240 and +2 at K=9,216; K=14,336 is ABOVE the whole measured span, so the extrapolation is +0 or worse and +0 is the floor a ladder rung can take (lambda -> infinity returns the prior exactly, which is the control's bytes).  Canonical +1 because ARCH.V14CL896 and ARCH.V14CL896G03 both read one above their sealed count.

predictions.source: MX37-V16CL896, rebuilt this wave from MX34-CL896 at K=16,384, checked BIT-IDENTICAL against wave 23's sealed 55061febb9795b42 -- a fourteen-wave, three-builder reproduction control that costs nothing
predictions.reasoning: SAME MONOTONE-IN-K PRIOR, and K=16,384 is further above the measured span than K=14,336, so +0 again.  THE NAMED ALTERNATIVE, and it is the one this file would bet second: K=16,384's control is anomalously LOW (one, where every neighbouring K reads two) and its lambda 0.3 arm is the only +2 outside K=12,288.  If that headroom is a property of the BASE rather than of lambda 0.3, lambda 1.0 recovers it too and this child reads THREE.  A reading of 3 confirms the base-headroom account; a reading of 1 confirms the monotone account; a reading of 2 splits them and settles nothing.

predictions.source: a NEW body: --ff 896 --excise 9, conditioned-local arm, ~300 s of GPU.  No wave has sealed it, so bodyq.sh will say NO SEALED CELL in those words rather than printing a reassuring line.
predictions.reasoning: THE BLOCK-COST PRIOR.  ARCH.CL896 seals 4; ARCH.CL896X13 seals 1, so block 13 costs THREE on this body.  Wave 27 measured block 9 at three to four on the shelf bases: V18 13->10 (-3) and V19 14->10 (-4) tie block 13's cost exactly, and V20 13->9 (-4) is one worse than block 13's -3.  Modal cost is three, so ONE.  THE NAMED ALTERNATIVE IS ZERO, on the V20 point and on the structural argument that block 9 is the only excision in this family that SHIFTS an attention block into a conv's slot.
predictions.what_would_be_a_result: TWO OR MORE.  That would make block 9 cheaper than block 13 on this body, which no measurement anywhere in the campaign supports, and it would give the 0.42x floor a second and better route.

predictions.source: K=12,288 on ARCH.CL896X09, one 40-second CPU vocabulary pass
predictions.reasoning: THE FLATNESS LAW.  The vocabulary fold on the CL896 family is flat: ARCH.CL896X13 seals 1 and ARCH.V12CL896X13 seals 1; ARCH.CL896 seals 4 and every CL896 vocabulary rung from K=20,480 down to K=9,216 seals 1 or 2.  So this child reads its body's count.  IT LANDS AT EXACTLY THE CAMPAIGN FLOOR RATIO, 0.420779x, tying ARCH.V12CL896X13 to the parameter -- which makes the pair the cleanest same-ratio, same-K, one-block-apart comparison the campaign has.

predictions.source: terminal gain lambda 0.3 on MX37-V12CL896X09, zero storage delta, ~100 s of GPU
predictions.reasoning: THE +1 LAW FAILS AT THIS RATIO AND WAVE 36 MEASURED THE FAILURE.  ARCH.V12CL896X13G03 tied its control at one by moving a lane SIDEWAYS -- gaining summarisation, losing the email -- despite the largest objective improvement any gain arm has recorded (relSSE 0.4117 -> 0.3176, 23 per cent).  Registered at the control's count on the excised-body precedent.  What would be informative even at a tie: whether the SAME lane swap happens on a different excision index.  If it does, the swap is a property of the 0.42x rung; if it does not, it is a property of block 13.

predictions.source: terminal gain lambda 1.0 on MX37-V12CL896X09, zero storage delta, ~100 s of GPU
predictions.reasoning: THIS IS THE WAVE'S ONE BET ON MOVEMENT AND IT IS THE MONOTONE-IN-K PRIOR RUN OFF ITS OWN END.  lambda 1.0 gains +0 / +1 / +2 as K falls 12,288 / 10,240 / 9,216 on the unexcised body.  This child is at K=12,288 on an EXCISED body whose stored ratio (0.420779x) is BELOW the K=9,216 rung (0.437349x) where lambda 1.0 bought two.  If the trend is in the RATIO rather than in K, this arm buys at least one over its body's predicted one.  If the trend is in K, it buys nothing and reads one.  NOBODY HAS RUN LAMBDA 1.0 ON AN EXCISED DEEP BODY -- wave 36 ran only lambda 0.3 there -- so this is the first observation that can separate the two accounts.
predictions.what_it_would_move: A reading of 2 takes the sealed 2/15 rung from ARCH.V9CL896 at 0.437349x to 0.420779x, a move of 0.016570 of stored ratio, and it would make the campaign floor hold two cases instead of one.  A reading of 3 would take the sealed 3/15 rung by 0.016570 as well.  A reading of 1 leaves every rung where it is and still settles that lambda 1.0's advantage tracks K and not ratio, which is the thing worth knowing.

F3_the_two_case_adjudication.what_was_ordered: Run the paraphrase-triplet read on ARCH.V14CL896G03's planning lane and on ARCH.V9CL896G10's +1 lanes, so the deep record's counts carry a robustness annotation.
F3_the_two_case_adjudication.a_constraint_registered_BEFORE_the_read_: mx37_pararubric.py declares TWO lanes UNANSWERABLE on this bank and refuses to score them: context-retrieval and summarization-priorities.  All six of their restatements say 'the note below' / 'the update' and carry NO note and NO update, because the sealed prompts supply that material inline and the paraphrase bank dropped it.  ARCH.V9CL896G10's four sealed lanes are context-retrieval, summarization-priorities, writing-concise-email and uncertainty-insufficient-data -- so TWO OF ITS FOUR, INCLUDING THE +1 LANE THAT DISTINGUISHES IT FROM EVERY OTHER RUNG OF ITS LADDER, CANNOT BE ADJUDICATED ON THIS SURFACE AT ALL.  That is a bank defect, it is declared here before the read rather than discovered in the output, and the honest deliverable is a robustness annotation on two lanes and a stated hole on the other two.

predicted_readings.ARCH.V14CL896G03 planning-dependencies: ABSENT (0 of 3).  The sealed lane is a lenient read of five named work items followed by a loop; the paraphrase restatements do not supply the project list, and the PARENT itself holds only 12 of 39 scorable restatements across the whole bank.
predicted_readings.ARCH.V9CL896G10 writing-concise-email: ABSENT (0 of 3).  The sealed lane is a FIRST-PERSON RESTATEMENT of the instruction, not an email; a restatement is exactly the thing a reworded prompt breaks.
predicted_readings.ARCH.V9CL896G10 uncertainty-insufficient: FRAGILE (1 of 3).  It is the one lane in the deep family whose content is a LIST OF NAMED QUANTITIES rather than a form, and named content is what survives rewording when anything does.

F3_the_two_case_adjudication.what_this_read_can_and_cannot_settle: It CANNOT settle the canonical 5/15 rung, because that rung rests on the planning-dependencies rule applied to ARCH.V9CL896G10 and on its context-retrieval lane, and the second of those is unscorable here.  It CAN say whether the lanes that ARE scorable survive their own ask reworded, which is the annotation the deep record is missing.
